title: bug: a CLI that fails fast at launch (provider usage limit) makes the wrapper land and push a board-only checkpoint on every backoff retry
description: Measured by the governor on 2026-09-19. During a provider usage-limit window the CLI exits 1 within seconds of launch. The wrapper already classifies this ("CLI exits within 120s of launch (exit 1, 3 in a row) ... backing off up to 900s") but still runs a full post-flight landing on every retry. Each landing is a wip checkpoint whose only path is the task's own .moe/tasks/<id>.json (the claim touched the record), and it is pushed. Result: qa-7100be29 put 14 commits "wip(task-d1441364…) [status=REVIEW role=qa cli-exit=1]" on moe/work-2026-09-13 between 10:18Z and 12:36Z, and 46 cli-exit=1 checkpoint commits landed between 2026-09-18 20:00Z and 2026-09-19 12:50Z. None of them carries work, and they bury the real history. Board state is not lost by skipping them: the next real landing stages the task's BOARD path anyway. Proposed rule, identical in both twins: when an exit is classified as a launch failure and the landing would contain only BOARD paths, skip the checkpoint and log the skip. A launch-failure exit that has real (non-BOARD) dirty owned paths still lands as today.
definitionOfDone: A launch-failure exit whose landing would contain only the task's BOARD path lands no commit and logs a named skip, in both moe-agent.ps1 and moe-agent.sh
A launch-failure exit with a real owned code path still lands its checkpoint; a postflight arm per twin covers both cases and the skip arm fails on the old launchers
parity-check.{sh,ps1} pin the skip code; postflight.sh, postflight.ps1 (pwsh and PS 5.1) and both parity checks pass

implementationPlan.description: Add tests first in both postflight harnesses, next to Scenario P, using make_scope_project/run_scope_wrapper and New-ScopeProject/Invoke-GateWrapper. Capture pre-fix wrapper bytes to a uniquely owned scratch tree, verify the task-bound baseline/prerequisite and preserve foreign WIP. Add named P2 subcases with a fake CLI that exits 1 immediately; use role=qa, final REVIEW, tracked dirty own task record, checkpointPush=true and an isolated local bare remote. (a) BOARD-only: assert unchanged HEAD/branch/remote tip, zero committed checkpoint/rescue rows and no push attempt, board file still dirty, exact MOE_CHECKPOINT_SKIPPED_LAUNCH_FAILURE_BOARD_ONLY in log and nothing record. Include a staged foreign path and prove its index/worktree bytes stay intact. (b) Same fast exit with an actual owned non-BOARD change: exactly one wip checkpoint, exact owned+board paths/content, exit 1 retained in ledger and successful remote update, no skip. (c) Repeat BOARD-only failure on the same repository, then do a successful owned-code invocation: no intermediate recovered/board-only commit; later real checkpoint includes retained BOARD bytes. Add controls: exit 0 BOARD-only checkpoint still lands; exit 1 with MOE_LAUNCH_FAIL_SEC=0 still lands; worker REVIEW completion is not suppressed. Also cover no-candidate and ordinary recovery via existing assertions or focused additional subcases. Restore every fixture environment override in cleanup/finally; use existing bounded process helpers. Obtain focused RED proof against pre-fix twins before implementation: failure must be the unchanged-HEAD/commit-count assertion, not merely the absent log token. DoD 1-2.

Implement the PowerShell twin. Reset an explicitly named current-invocation launch-failure boolean each loop and assign it using the EXISTING native-exit/elapsed predicate; leave streak/backoff/resume accounting untouched. Add optional internal [bool]$LaunchFailed=$false to Invoke-MoeLanding and pass it only from normal postflight; recovery calls retain the false default. After successful scope/attribution and before branch peel/private-index staging, recognize ONLY Kind=checkpoint, not recovered, LaunchFailed=true, nonempty Candidates, and every candidate.Reason exactly BOARD. Emit [skip] MOE_CHECKPOINT_SKIPPED_LAUNCH_FAILURE_BOARD_ONLY with task identity and explanation that dirty BOARD state is deferred. Return the existing Outcome=nothing with Code set, empty SHA/ref, PathCount=0, Pushed=false and StopLoop=false. Use the ordinary no-landing bookkeeping: write the unchanged B plus current unattributed U using Get-MoeBaselineLandedFlag and original session, send best-effort record_commit outcome=nothing with this code and existing diagnostics, preserve normal finalization/marker cleanup. Do not remove BOARD files, prune them as committed, peel branches, run a gate, create rescue/commit/receipt or push on the skip. Explicit error handling: preserve existing exception handling; snapshot/attribution failures stay failures, not skips. Add concise why-comments at the guard and update the existing blanket board-only-lands comment. Compatible with pwsh and PS5.1; no change to the prerequisite supervisor. DoD 1-2.

Implement identical semantics in Bash. Reset a per-invocation boolean and set it from the existing classifier, then pass it as an optional run_landing argument only at normal postflight (default false for all existing recovery callers); do not use the historical streak as landing authority. Determine BOARD-only from the already resolved candidate reason tags, not git status or declarations: add a non-BOARD candidate count to the resolver's summary and its loader, initialize the new count to an unknown sentinel, and require valid zero plus positive N_CANDIDATES before skipping. After successful attribution and existing failure guards but before land_commit, recognize checkpoint/current launch failure/not recovered/nonempty all-BOARD, set LAND_OUTCOME=nothing and LAND_CODE=MOE_CHECKPOINT_SKIPPED_LAUNCH_FAILURE_BOARD_ONLY. Flow through the shared nothing epilogue rather than bypass bookkeeping. Make the nothing log and record_commit_rpc preserve LAND_CODE (defaulting to MOE_COMMIT_NOTHING_TO_COMMIT only for ordinary nothing), retain zero paths/empty SHA/no push, and carry the code in session summary. Preserve baseline_after_landing with the existing session-safe landed flag and empty committed-path list, so the next retry cannot recover a skipped board-only checkpoint. Preserve diagnostics/unattributed U, finalize and live-marker/teardown handling. Explicit error handling: failed snapshot/attribution or unknown count must never become proof for a skip; maintain existing conservative error paths. Keep NUL-delimited records and path quoting intact; document the deliberate deferral inline. DoD 1-2.

Pin MOE_CHECKPOINT_SKIPPED_LAUNCH_FAILURE_BOARD_ONLY in both parity scripts' explicit required reason-code inventories, not only the automatic token-set equality check. Keep all existing pins and internal-plumbing exemptions unchanged. In scratch verification, removing the new marker from either twin, and from both together, must make each parity checker fail for this required code. Use ASCII text so BOM-less Windows PowerShell 5.1 reads the same literal. DoD 3.

Run the single concentrated verification gate on a stable, identified scratch snapshot containing the intended scripts tree; do not run long suites against live peers' changing wrapper files. From that snapshot root in pwsh on Windows, execute this exact compound command and retain its native exit plus concise pass/count summaries for complete_task.verification:
$env:MOE_POSTFLIGHT_TIMEOUT_SEC='400'; & 'C:\Program Files\Git\bin\bash.exe' -c 'bash -n scripts/moe-agent.sh scripts/tests/postflight.sh scripts/tests/parity-check.sh && bash scripts/tests/postflight.sh && bash scripts/tests/parity-check.sh'; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; node scripts/tests/postflight-safe.mjs pwsh; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; node scripts/tests/postflight-safe.mjs powershell; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; & pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/tests/parity-check.ps1; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; & powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/tests/parity-check.ps1; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; node --test scripts/tests/agent-runtime.test.mjs scripts/tests/taskless-handoff.test.mjs; exit $LASTEXITCODE
Require full postflight.sh, full postflight.ps1 on BOTH pwsh and Windows PowerShell 5.1, both parity scripts (PS on both engines), and Node tests to pass without SKIP. Verify positive scenario execution, not just an empty test selection. Retain the focused pre-fix-vs-fixed evidence for every P2 skip/owned-code arm on Bash, pwsh and PS5.1; mutant runs and parity-pin removal happen only in separate disposable trees, never by swapping live launchers. Old code must actually commit the unwanted BOARD checkpoint; fixed code must not. Check later real landing and retry baseline evidence, including no recovery/teardown backdoor. Bash uses Git Bash explicitly on Windows to avoid accidentally selecting WSL; on Linux/macOS the Bash leg uses native bash and POSIX paths, while PS5.1 proof still requires Windows. Report real unavailable-engine/infrastructure failures, never call skipped coverage passing. DoD 1-3.

Perform the final adversarial self-review (load adversarial-self-review and regression-check before completion) of this task's diff only. Check: repeated retries and a later successful CLI; recovery/default-argument isolation; no launched CLI/null or unknown timing; threshold boundary and nonzero code outside the window; empty candidates; all BOARD versus one real ASSERTED/TOOL/PLANNED/MEASURED candidate, including deletion; commitBoardState=false still does not redefine own BOARD; foreign staged/dirty/unattributed paths; failed attribution/RPC/baseline writes keep existing handling; skip never peels/commits/pushes/rescues; only the owning session's baseline becomes handled; finalization and operator summary say nothing with the exact skip code, not committed/failed. Check concurrency and private-index/CAS guards remain untouched. Run git diff --check scoped to the six owned paths and inspect diff against the recorded baseline, preserving all foreign edits. Attach DoD-to-test mapping, red/green evidence and the fresh compound gate result in Moe step/completion notes, then complete_task for QA; do not manually land, push, install or bypass the wrapper. Handle any QA rejection within these same rails, with fresh verification after a fix. No separate docs/API change is needed beyond guard comments and parity vocabulary.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered: Human confirmed in the REPL: skip checkpoints only when the current exit satisfies the existing launch-failure classifier and every attributed candidate is BOARD; preserve owned-code checkpoints, successful exits, completion and recovery landings. Rejected skipping all nonzero exits, disabling board commits globally, testing the whole dirty checkout, using declared file counts/extensions as proof of real changes, and returning before attribution or session bookkeeping. Use an additive optional INTERNAL landing input and the existing nothing outcome; no MCP schema, project setting, state migration, provider-output parsing, or change to retry/backoff policy. The six edited paths are the three explicitly required Bash/PowerShell twin pairs, one tightly coupled bugfix; no seventh documentation/helper file.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights: Explored live launcher classifiers, attribution, landing epilogues, recovery and harnesses. Existing predicate: nonzero native CLI exit and 0 <= elapsed < MOE_LAUNCH_FAIL_SEC (default 120). Both classify before postflight but never feed that fact to landing. Bash run_landing resolves NUL-delimited (reason, blob, path) candidates and uses a summary; PowerShell Invoke-MoeLanding gets attr.Candidates with Reason. BOARD is an attribution tier, not a filename extension or arbitrary .moe prefix. Both early nothing paths can maintain baseline/session state without commit or push. Bash's nothing log and record_commit_rpc currently hard-code MOE_COMMIT_NOTHING_TO_COMMIT; preserve a new skip code through both and through LAND_SUMMARY_CODE. Complete-MoePostflight/finalize_postflight already map nothing to nothing-to-commit. Get-MoeBaselineLandedFlag/baseline_landed_flag protect foreign-session baselines. record_commit accepts a string code and outcome=nothing; no daemon edit is required. Reuse scenario-P board fixtures and existing scope helpers rather than add another harness.
planningNotes.risks: Dependency task-84150869c3194fce908e6efad8f4c82b is already visible in current branch history at 021f351 (implementation), 469ed6d (QA board); recheck its landing and worker ownership at execution time, preserve its PS supervisor. Planning inspected HEAD 9f2cce3be83adf80e72fdccbde09072d22c1e379; this is a shared moving checkout with foreign WIP. Do not stage/revert/stash it or edit runtime .moe records. Test only owned changes over an identified source snapshot, not an accidental mixture of peers' half-written launchers. A skip must acknowledge only this session's baseline without pruning deferred board bytes, leave unresolved/foreign paths and real recovery intact, and not trigger teardown rescue. Do not pass sticky failure-streak state to recovery. Missing/failed attribution is not proof of BOARD-only content. Never broaden the change to completion paths or weaken private-index, CAS, receipt/finalize, contested-path, or quality-gate guards. PS5.1-compatible syntax and ASCII skip marker; Bash candidate records remain NUL-safe. Full Bash harness can exceed the safe runner's 20-minute cap, hence direct Bash invocation in the gate; Windows safe-runner legs also exercise node-to-powershell launch inheritance.
